rules.content:
title: TDS Redirect Chain Depth Anomaly
status: experimental
description: Detects HTTP redirect chains (302, 301, or JavaScript-based redirects) exceeding a depth threshold where intermediate nodes are newly registered domains or have low reputation scores, indicating Traff
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    service: web_proxy
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "http_redirect_chain"
        redirect_type|contains:
            - "301"
            - "302"
            - "javascript_redirect"
    chain_depth:
        redirect_hop_count|gte: 4
    intermediate_reputation:
        intermediate_domain_max_age_days|lte: 30
        intermediate_domain_min_reputation|lte: 20
    condition: selection and chain_depth and intermediate_reputation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0095: TDS Redirect Chain Depth Anomaly (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: TDS Cloaking Behavior Detection
status: experimental
description: Detects domains serving divergent content based on visitor attributes such as geolocation, device fingerprint, or user agent, a technique known as cloaking. TDS operators serve benign or empty content
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    service: web_proxy
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "http_response_divergence"
        target_domain_age_days|lte: 90
    scanner_response:
        visitor_profile: "scanner"
        response_category|contains:
            - "200_benign"
            - "200_empty"
            - "403_blocked"
    residential_response:
        visitor_profile: "residential"
        response_category|contains:
            - "302_redirect"
            - "301_redirect"
            - "javascript_redirect"
            - "malicious_content"
    content_divergence:
        response_similarity_score|lte: 0.2
    condition: selection and scanner_response and residential_response and content_divergence
level: high
rules.title: DL-0096: TDS Cloaking Behavior Detection (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: TDS Shared Infrastructure Correlation
status: experimental
description: Detects domains from different apparent campaigns sharing hosting infrastructure, nameservers, or registration patterns — indicating a common TDS operator serving multiple affiliates. This rule perfor
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    service: dns_resolution
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "passive_dns_resolution"
        ip_cidr_overlap|gte: 2
        registrant_divergence: true
        registration_time_delta|lte: "72h"
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 5
        groupby: "ip_cidr_24"
        timeframe: "7d"
    condition: selection and aggregation
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0097: TDS Shared Infrastructure Correlation (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Bulk Let's Encrypt Certificate Issuance Clustering
status: experimental
description: Detects clusters of Let's Encrypt certificate issuances for domains sharing nameserver or registrar characteristics within a short time window. RDGA and AI-generated campaigns frequently provision cer
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    service: ct_log
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "certificate_issuance"
        issuer_org: "Let's Encrypt"
        registration_to_cert_delta|lte: "24h"
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 15
        groupby: "nameserver_cluster"
        timeframe: "6h"
    condition: selection and aggregation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0099: Bulk Let's Encrypt Certificate Issuance Clustering (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Zone File Daily Diff Anomaly Detection
status: experimental
description: Detects anomalous patterns in daily zone file diffs: unusual volume of new registrations in a single TLD, concentration of registrations at specific registrars, or patterns suggesting algorithmic gene
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    service: zone_file_diff
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "zone_file_new_entry"
        registration_volume_zscore|gte: 3.0
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 50
        groupby: "registrar_id, tld"
        timeframe: "24h"
    condition: selection and aggregation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0100: Zone File Daily Diff Anomaly Detection (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Investment TDS Geo-Routing to Legitimate Platform
status: experimental
description: Detect Traffic Distribution System (TDS) geo-routing patterns used in investment scam infrastructure: (1) same domain resolving to different IP addresses based on requester geography, (2) US-based vis
logsource:
    product: dns
    category: dns_analytics
    service: passive_dns
detection:
    selection_geo_variance:
        domain_ip_geo_variance: true
        unique_resolution_ips|gte: 3
        geo_routing_detected: true
    selection_legitimate_redirect:
        redirect_target|contains:
            - "etoro.com"
            - "coinbase.com"
            - "robinhood.com"
            - "fidelity.com"
        source_geo: "US"
    selection_cname_tds:
        cname_chain_length|gte: 2
        cname_target_domain_age_days|lt: 30
        cname_routing_pattern: true
    selection_domain_age:
        domain_registration_age_days|lt: 30
        non_us_redirect_target: true
    condition: (selection_geo_variance and selection_legitimate_redirect) or (selection_cname_tds and selection_domain_age)
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0120: Investment TDS Geo-Routing to Legitimate Platform (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Keitaro/Binom TDS Abuse Infrastructure Detection")`
`comment("HTTP redirect chain analysis for TDS abuse patterns")`
index=flame_proxy sourcetype=flame:http_log
(url_query="*click_id=*" OR url_query="*campaign_id=*" OR url_query="*keitaro*" OR url_query="*binom*" OR url_query="*cnv_id=*")
OR (url_path="*/tracker/*" OR url_path="*/click/*" OR url_path="*/go/*" OR url_path="*/click.php*")
| transaction session_id maxspan=30s
| where eventcount>=3
| eval redirect_chain=mvjoin(url, " -> ")
| eval has_keitaro=if(like(url_query, "%keitaro%") OR like(url_path, "%/tracker/%"), 1, 0)
| eval has_binom=if(like(url_query, "%binom%") OR like(url_path, "%/click.php%"), 1, 0)
| where has_keitaro=1 OR has_binom=1
| stats count values(redirect_chain) as chains values(final_destination) as destinations by src_ip session_id
rules.title: DL-0122: Keitaro/Binom TDS Abuse Infrastructure Detection (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for TDS URL Parameter Fingerprint Tracking")`
`comment("Identifies consistent TDS parameter patterns across rotating domains")`
index=flame_proxy sourcetype=flame:http_log http_status IN (301, 302, 307)
(url_query="*?u=*&o=*" OR url_query="*aff_id=*&click_id=*" OR url_query="*subid=*&source=*&clickid=*" OR url_query="*pid=*&offer_id=*")
| rex field=url_query "(?<param_pattern>[a-z_]+=)[^&]*(&[a-z_]+=)[^&]*"
| eval param_fingerprint=param_pattern
| lookup domain_age_feed dest_domain OUTPUT domain_age_days
| where domain_age_days < 90 OR isnull(domain_age_days)
| stats dc(dest_domain) AS unique_domains
        values(dest_domain) AS domains
        dc(src_ip) AS unique_visitors
        count AS total_hits
        earliest(_time) AS first_seen
        latest(_time) AS last_seen
    by param_fingerprint
| where unique_domains >= 3
| sort -unique_domains
rules.title: DL-0127: TDS URL Parameter Fingerprint Tracking Across Rotating Domains (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Blank CC Subscription Fraud Pattern Detection")`
`comment("Identifies nominal-charge-to-recurring-subscription patterns (Ad Trafficko model)")`
index=flame_txn sourcetype=flame:card_transactions transaction_type=CNP
| eval is_nominal=(if(amount<=2.99, 1, 0))
| eval is_recurring_followup=(if(transaction_type="recurring" AND amount>=6.99, 1, 0))
| stats
    sum(is_nominal) AS nominal_charges
    sum(is_recurring_followup) AS recurring_charges
    dc(card_hash) AS unique_cards
    avg(amount) AS avg_amount
    max(amount) AS max_amount
    values(merchant_descriptor) AS descriptors
    latest(merchant_chargeback_ratio) AS chargeback_ratio
  by merchant_id
| where nominal_charges > 10 AND recurring_charges > 5
| eval conversion_ratio=round(recurring_charges/nominal_charges, 2)
| where conversion_ratio > 0.3 OR chargeback_ratio > 0.05
| sort -recurring_charges
rules.title: DL-0128: Blank Credit Card Subscription Fraud Pattern Detection (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Fake Mobile App Residential Proxy and Subscription Scam Detection")`
`comment("Detects VexTrio-pattern fake apps: residential proxy abuse and notification-to-subscription scam cycle")`

`comment("--- Detection 1: Fake VPN acting as residential proxy ---")`
index=flame_endpoint sourcetype=flame:mobile_mdm app_category IN ("VPN", "cleaner", "optimizer", "spam-blocker")
| stats
    dc(dest_ip) AS unique_dest_ips
    sum(bytes_out) AS total_bytes_out
    sum(bytes_in) AS total_bytes_in
    dc(src_port) AS unique_src_ports
    values(app_name) AS app_names
  by device_id, app_id
| eval proxy_ratio=round(total_bytes_in/total_bytes_out, 2)
| where unique_dest_ips > 50 AND proxy_ratio > 2
| eval risk="residential_proxy_behavior"

`comment("--- Detection 2: Push notification abuse to subscription scam cycle ---")`
index=flame_endpoint sourcetype=flame:mobile_mdm
| eval has_notification_spike=(if(push_notification_count_24h >= 50, 1, 0))
| eval has_app_install=(if(isnotnull(new_app_install) AND app_category IN ("spam-blocker", "notification-protector", "cleaner"), 1, 0))
| eval has_subscription=(if(in_app_purchase_amount >= 6.99 AND in_app_purchase_type="subscription", 1, 0))
| transaction device_id maxspan=72h
| where has_notification_spike=1 AND has_app_install=1 AND has_subscription=1
| eval risk="notification_to_subscription_scam_cycle"
rules.title: DL-0129: Fake Mobile App Residential Proxy and Subscription Scam Detection (SPLUNK)
